Two '''members''' of a [[Voegliss's species|sentient species]], together with their [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] [[Voegliss|son]], were present on a supposedly uninhabited [[Unidentified world (Voegliss)|world]] at one point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. There, the two adults attacked the team of the Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Devlor Samt]].<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
